visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young East Asian male with short black hair, wearing a cream-colored ribbed knit sweater and light grey sweatpants, sits on a wooden chair against a stark white wall. He holds a light brown acoustic guitar with a patterned strap, strumming it with his right hand while fingering chords with his left, looking directly at the camera with an expressive singing face. (2) The scene cuts to a medium shot of the man in a dark green t-shirt, lying in a bed with a dark grey headboard and grey pillows. He looks physically exhausted, staring blankly at the ceiling before slowly sitting up and pulling a white duvet away, exhibiting a weary facial expression. (3) He is then seen in a well-lit office environment, wearing a white t-shirt under a blue denim jacket. He sits at a cluttered wooden desk with a silver laptop open; he appears stressed, rubbing his closed eyes and temples with both hands as if suffering from a headache. (4) Transitioning to a dimly lit bedroom at night, he lies horizontally across the bed, holding a black smartphone above his face. The blue light from the screen reflects on his skin as he scrolls with a tired, focused gaze. (5) In a return to the office setting, he picks up a bright yellow cardboard box labeled with Brand's and Suntory logos. He opens the top flap to reveal several orange-packaged Ginseng Jelly sachets, holding one up to demonstrate the product's portability. (6) A dynamic montage follows where he is seen in a gym with treadmills behind him, then in an office, and back in his bedroom. In each location, he tears open a sachet and eats the jelly while superimposed, semi-transparent images of his face appear to sing the background harmonies. (7) He is seen walking through a brightly lit convenience store aisle with refrigerated drink cases in the background. He reaches out and grabs a yellow product box from the shelf, turning it toward the camera with a satisfied smile. (8) He holds a small brown glass bottle of liquid supplement, twists off the cap, and drinks the contents. After finishing, he raises a determined fist and smiles confidently, indicating a surge in energy. (9) The video concludes with him in bed wearing a grey t-shirt; he wakes up with a bright expression, stretching both arms high above his head as the morning light fills the room.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear -> Montage: Problem introduction through song -> Product solution demonstration -> Lifestyle benefits and availability summary.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a creative commercial for Brand's Ginseng Jelly and Essence of Chicken. It uses an original acoustic song to narrate common relatable daily struggles—tiredness at work and inability to sleep—before introducing the product as a convenient source of energy and vitality 'anytime' and 'anywhere'.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator directly sings about the product benefits, shows the packaging clearly, consumes it on camera, and provides information on where to buy it.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The use of a catchy original song and humorous 'multiple faces' editing creates high engagement. The product's convenience (jelly form) is the central USP highlighted.
